introHtml: Kraft material gives gift sets and bundles a natural, eco-friendly look that stands out from standard packaging. Whether you are assembling welcome kits for new hires or promotional bundles for a trade show, the brown kraft finish conveys sustainability and craftsmanship. It pairs well with screen-printed logos or foil stamping for a clean brand impression. Choose custom kraft gift sets and bundles to align your company swag with environmental values.
